aboutMe.sectionContent: I'm a web developer who started learning frontend development in 2020 and expanded into full-stack development in 2024.

projects.sectionDescription: I don't have many projects, as I tend to spend more time diving deep into specific topics. Here are some of the projects I've built along the way. 😅

odiano.description: A social media platform built for sharing posts, discovering content, and connecting with others.

tokosl88.description: Company profile landing page for Tokosl88, a retail store in Tangerang. Built to highlight product offerings and connect customers directly to store info.

arthahub.description: This one look like a joke 😅, indeed. I build this for my civics class in high school. If you want to try it out, You can only visit homepage, dashboard and page in quick link (Tentang arthahub -> link cepat).

antelocode.description: A portfolio website for Antelocode, my freelance development profile.

usercloud.description: A single company landing page I make for studying.

cinehunt.description: A movie database website for cinema lovers. I build this to learn how to use third party api.

phont.description: A fake company website i made for study, this website has no responsive design, and yes, this one is look like a joke too 😅.
